write_up: Your resume points to family services casework: you work with families involved with child protective services at Cuyahoga Family Partners, after intake work at Lakeview Community Center. This is a common pattern on social work resumes: the duties are named, but the caseload and the decisions behind them aren't. That makes it harder to stand out when a recruiter is comparing caseworkers.

The monthly family team meetings line is the best model: it names an activity you facilitate and tells a recruiter how often. Your Ohio LMSW and MSW are easy to find, and your experience comes first. One short description of Cuyahoga Family Partners would also give a reader context for the setting.
